facts.claim: The Raja of Coorg agreed to send an elephant each year to the Company in lieu of the former tribute of Rs. 24,000.
facts.quote: Before Capt. Mahoney left, it was settled that the Raja of Coorg should every year send an elephant to the Company in lieu of the former tribute of Rs. 24,000.

facts.claim: The Raja collected large supplies of rice and forwarded them to Seringapatam, saving the troops from famine.
facts.quote: He has collected large supplies of rice and forwarded them to Seringapatam, thus saving the troops from famine.

facts.claim: The Raja furnished 1,000 coolies to the army and 2,000 men for the conveyance of ammunition to Seringapatam without receiving remuneration.
facts.quote: He has furnished 1 ,000 coolies to the army, and 2,000 men for the conveyance of the ammunition to Seringapatam, without receiving remuneration.
